name: Marion Tavares
text:
You have 1 fewer hand slots.
[reaction] After you play an event during your turn: Draw 1 card. Then, you may play a different event. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an event and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Trait Choice: At deck creation, choose one of the following traits: [[Fortune]], [[Gambit]], or [[Improvised]]. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, events with your chosen [[Trait]] level 0-2, up to 5 other level 0 Survivor cards ([survivor]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Two copies of Determined, "I'll do it myself," 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "People rely on me to do my job. A few odd fish in the water don't change that."

name: Determined
text:
Marion Tavares deck only.
If this skill test is successful and it is on an event you played, you may return Determined to your hand instead of discarding it.

name: "I'll do it myself"
text: Revelation - Put "I'll do it myself" into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to play an event, take 1 horror. [fast] Discard 3 events from your hand: Discard "I'll do it myself."

name: Lucius Galloway
text:
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each enemy at your location.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Book of Verse, Dreams of the Flood, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I'm just glad all my dreams have stayed in my head."

name: Book of Verse
text:
Lucius Galloway deck only.
Uses (1 inspiration). Replenish this inspiration the first time you discover a clue each round.
[reaction] After revealing chaos tokens during a skill test, spend 1 inspiration: You get +1 skill value for this skill test. If you succeed by exactly 0, draw 1 card.

name: Dreams of the Flood
text: Revelation - Put Dreams of the Flood into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you discover 1 or more clues during your turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Dreams of the Flood into your deck.

name: Agatha Crane
text:
[reaction] When your turn ends, if you sealed, canceled, or ignored 1 or more chaos tokens this round: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may cancel this token and draw another in its place. If you do, draw 1 card.
backText: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Insight]] events level 0-3, up to 10 other level 0 Mystic cards ([mystic]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Ocula Obscura, Glimpse the Void, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Agatha Crane
text:
[reaction] When your turn ends, if you sealed, canceled, or ignored 1 or more chaos tokens this round: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may cancel this token and draw another in its place. If you do, draw 1 card.
backText: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Spell]] events level 0-3, up to 10 other level 0 Seeker cards ([seeker]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Ocula Obscura, Glimpse the Void, 1 random basic weakness.

name: Ocula Obscura
text: Agatha Crane deck only. [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test, if no tokens are sealed here and you did not release a token from Ocula Obscura during this skill test: Seal a non-symbol token revealed during this skill test on Ocula Obscura. (Limit once per phase.) Forced - When you would reveal a token from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here instead, then release that token.

name: Glimpse the Void
text: Revelation - Put Glimpse the Void into play in your threat area. The first time you reveal 1 or more chaos tokens during each skill test, you must reveal 1 additional chaos token (and resolve its effects). [action]: Shuffle Glimpse the Void into your deck.

name: Michael McGlen
text:
[reaction] After you spend 1 or more ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset: Gain 1 resource. (Limit once per [[Firearm]] asset per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may place 1 ammo on a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards with [[Firearm]] either as their Trait or in their text box level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): "Viola" Case, Confiscation, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "Don't care if it's a god. If it crosses me, it's gonna regret it."

name: "Viola" Case
text:
Michael McGlen deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Firearm]] assets.
[reaction] After you play "Viola" Case: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Firearm]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Confiscation
text: Revelation - Shuffle each [[Firearm]] asset in your play area into your deck. If no asset was shuffled into your deck by this effect, take 1 damage and shuffle Confiscation back into your deck.
flavor: "You, uh... going hunting, Mr. McGlen?"

name: Gloria Goldberg
text:
You choose the investigator order during the mythos phase.
[reaction] When you look at 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Look at 1 additional card and choose 1 non-[[Elite]] card among them. Either discard it, put it on top of the encounter deck, or place it facedown beneath Gloria Goldberg (max 3 cards beneath her).
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Look at the top card of the encounter deck.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian ([guardian]), Seeker ([seeker]), or Rogue ([rogue]). Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Psychic Sensitivity, 3 copies of Prophecy of the End (shuffled into the encounter deck), 1 random basic weakness.

name: Psychic Sensitivity
text:
Gloria Goldberg deck only.
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location draws an encounter card, if there is a copy of that encounter card beneath Gloria Goldberg.
Cancel all of that card's effects and discard both copies of it. Then, draw 1 card.

name: Prophecy of the End
text: Surge. Forced - If Gloria Goldberg uses her [reaction] ability and this treachery is among the looked-at cards, it must be chosen and placed facedown beneath her (if you cannot, discard a non-weakness card beneath her first). Then, if there are 3 copies of this treachery beneath her, she is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.

name: George Barnaby
text:
Your max hand size is equal to the number of facedown cards beneath George Barnaby. (Limit 5 cards.)
You may commit facedown cards beneath George Barnaby to skill tests as if they were in your hand.
[reaction] After you discard a card from your hand: Place it facedown beneath George Barnaby, then draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card.
backText: Deck Size: 35. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 other level 0 Seeker and/or Rogue cards ([seeker]/[rogue]). Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Grim Resolve, Cast Adrift, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Setup: After drawing your opening hand, you may place any number of cards in your hand facedown beneath George Barnaby.

name: Grim Resolve
text:
George Barnaby deck only.
After this skill test resolves, you may swap any number of cards beneath George Barnaby with the same number of non-weakness cards in your hand.

name: Cast Adrift
text: Revelation - If there are no cards beneath George Barnaby, shuffle Cast Adrift into your deck. Otherwise, discard each card beneath George Barnaby.

name: The Book of War
text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[reaction] After you play a [[Tactic]] event, spend 1 secret and exhaust The Book of War: When your turn ends, return that event to your hand.
flavor: "Who wishes to fight must first count the cost."

name: Crowbar
text: [action] Exhaust Crowbar: Investigate. This investigation attempt uses [combat] instead of [intellect]. [action] Exhaust Crowbar: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack.

name: Remington Model 1858
text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] When Remington Model 1858 leaves play: Immediately trigger the above [action] ability, ignoring all costs.

name: Primed for Action
text:
Play only as your first action.
Play a [[Firearm]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. Then, you may play an [[Upgrade]] event from your hand, attaching it to that asset if able.

name: Ready for Anything
text:
Play only as your first action.
Draw 1 card (2 cards instead if you drew an enemy this round). Then, heal 1 horror. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Hardboiled
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Hardboiled gains [combat] [wild] for each successful attack you performed this round.
flavor: "If I come over there, there's going to be two sounds: me hitting you, twice."

name: Hunter's Mark
text:
Fast. Attach to an enemy at your location. Limit 1 per enemy.
Investigators get +1 [combat] while fighting this enemy.
[reaction] When damage is dealt to attached enemy, discard Hunter's Mark: Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

name: Alice Luxley
text: You get +1 [intellect]. The first investigate action you perform each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [reaction] After you discover a clue, exhaust Alice Luxley: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Card design inspired by the Council in Exile 2022.

name: Bulwark
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Seal ([elder_sign] or +1). You may resolve this keyword again after you defeat an enemy.
[reaction] When an enemy would attack an investigator at your location, exhaust Bulwark and release a token sealed here: Cancel that attack. Ready another asset you control.

name: Inspiring Presence
text: If this skill test is successful, ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage and 1 horror from it.
flavor: "Anderson's a hard-ass, sure. Always locking up the rum and waking us up at the crack of dawn. But out here in the middle of nowhere, he's definitely the one I want taking point."

name: Locked and Loaded
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
Your [[Firearm]] assets with "Uses (ammo)" enter play with 1 additional ammo on them.
flavor: "Millimeters don't make no difference, bullets just kinda kill you."

name: Quick Shot
text:
Myriad. Fast. Play only during your turn.
Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
[reaction] After you draw Quick Shot during your turn: Play it, reducing its resource cost by 2.
flavor: They called Sister Sofia the "hand of God" for a very good reason.

name: Remington Model 1858
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. [reaction] When Remington Model 1858 enters or leaves play: Immediately trigger the above [action] ability, ignoring all costs.

name: Alton O'Connell
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by exactly 3: Place 1 resource on Alton O'Connell, as evidence.
[fast] Exhaust Alton O'Connell and spend X evidence: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.

name: Artistic Inspiration
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (1 inspiration).
[fast] Exhaust Artistic Inspiration and discard 1 card from your hand: Replenish 1 inspiration on this card.
[reaction] After revealing chaos tokens for a skill test you are performing, spend 1 inspiration: You get +1 or -1 skill value for this skill test.

name: Dial of Ancients
text:
Limit 1 per deck. Uses (0 charges).
[reaction] After an enemy at your location is evaded: Place 1 charge on Dial of Ancients. Then, if there are 4 or more charges on Dial of Ancients, record in your campaign log that "you have calculated the day of reckoning."

name: Forensic Kit
text: Uses (4 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [agility] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed and there is an exhausted enemy at your location, heal 1 horror.

name: Mortar and Pestle
text: Uses (0 resources). Resources on Mortar and Pestle may be spent to pay for [[Spell]] cards. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Mortar and Pestle: Place 1 resource on it (from the token pool).

name: Oculus Mortuum
text:
Uses (0 evidence).
[reaction] After you seal, cancel, or ignore a chaos token, exhaust Oculus Mortuum: Place 1 evidence on it.
[reaction] When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, spend 1 evidence and exhaust Oculus Mortuum: Discover 1 clue at your location. If that enemy has the [[Geist]] trait, deal 1 damage to it.

name: Uncanny Specimen
text:
Myriad. Fast.
Up to 3 Uncanny Specimen cards take up 1 arcane slot.
[reaction] When a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, discard Uncanny Specimen: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. If this test is successful, draw 1 card.

name: Correlate All Its Contents
text: Investigate. You may cancel the first chaos token revealed for this skill test, return it to the bag, and reveal a new one. If you succeed at this skill test, place 1 charge or secret on an asset controlled by an investigator at your location (if you succeed by exactly 1 or 3, place 2 charges or secrets on that asset instead).

name: Cosmic Revelation
text: Choose "even" or "odd". Each investigator reveals each non-weakness card in their hand with a cost matching the chosen option. In player order, each investigator may choose to either draw 1 card from their deck, or play 1 card they revealed from their hand (paying its cost).

name: Quick-Witted
text:
Myriad.
Quick-Witted gains [intellect] [agility] for each other copy of Quick-Witted in your discard pile.
After this skill test ends, you may shuffle each other copy of Quick-Witted in your discard pile into your deck.

name: Misdirection
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Seal (+1 or 0). You may resolve this keyword again after you discover the last clue at your location.
[reaction] When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, exhaust Misdirection and release a token sealed here: Cancel that attack. Then, that investigator may move to a connecting location.

name: Scientific Studies Grant
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which may only be used to hold [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets.

name: Working a Hunch
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue from any revealed location.

name: Dial of Ancients
text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [reaction] When an investigator fails a skill test at your location, exhaust Dial of Ancients: Seal 1 chaos token revealed during that test on Dial of Ancients. Forced - When the round ends: For each chaos token sealed here, you must spend 1 charge or release that token.

name: Dial of Ancients
text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight/Evade. When you reveal a chaos token during this attack or evasion attempt, you may spend 1 charge to cancel that token, return it to the bag, and reveal a new one. You may do this any number of times. If this test succeeds, deal 1 damage to the targeted enemy.

name: Dial of Ancients
text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (4 charges). [fast] During your turn, exhaust Dial of Ancients and spend 1 charge: Investigate. When revealing chaos tokens for this test, reveal X additional tokens, where X is the number of enemies at your location. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest.

name: Antikythera
text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test, exhaust Antikythera: If you succeeded by...
-...exactly 1 or 3, discover 1 clue at your location.
-...exactly 2 or 4, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
-...exactly 5, you may take an additional action during your next turn.

name: Luger P08
text: Uses (2 ammo). [fast] Exhaust Luger P08 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. [action] Spend 1 resource: Replenish all ammo on Luger P08 and ready it.

name: Robert Castaigne
text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Discard a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand and exhaust Robert Castaigne: Resolve a Fight ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: String Along
text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy, exhaust String Along: For this evasion attempt, you get +1 skill value and that enemy gains alert. If you succeed, draw 1 card and do not disengage from that enemy.

name: "Where's the party?"
text: Parley. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a non-[[Elite]] enemy and spawn it exhausted and engaged with you. Draw cards equal to that enemy's combined damage and horror values.

name: "You've had worse..."
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may spend up to 3 resources. For each resource spent, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: Bum's Rush
text: Evade. Add your [combat] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 2 or more, deal that enemy 1 damage. If that enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move it to a connecting location.

name: Intimidation
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [combat] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's remaining health. If you succeed, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck (or deal 2 damage to it instead if it is [[Elite]]).
flavor: "You're in the wrong neighborhood, kid."

name: Crack Shot
text: Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset you control.

name: Doppelgänger
text: Myriad. Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] After an enemy enters or leaves attached location, return Doppelgänger to your hand: Either perform an evasion attempt against that enemy, or immediately move to attached location (you may trigger this ability from any location).

name: Mob Connections
text:
Exceptional.
[action] Spend 2 resources: Draw the card attached to Mob Connections.
[reaction] When an [[Illicit]] asset you control is discarded from play, exhaust Mob Connections: Attach that asset to this card, facedown. Limit 1 attached asset.

name: Obscure
text: Limit 1 per investigator. Seal (0). You may resolve this keyword again after you reveal a location or put a new location into play. [reaction] When you engage an enemy, exhaust Obscure and release a token sealed here: Immediately Fight or Evade that enemy. During this skill test, your base skill value is equal to the shroud value of your location.

name: "Watch this!"
text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
flavor: "You're still a show-off."

name: Robert Castaigne
text: You get +1 [combat]. [fast] Exhaust Robert Castaigne: Fight. Reveal a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand. Resolve a Fight ability on the revealed asset, ignoring all costs. Then, you may either discard the revealed asset to draw 1 card, or play that asset (paying its cost).

name: "You've had worse..."
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may give you up to 5 resources. For each resource given by this effect, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: Gatling Gun
text: Uses (12 ammo). [action] Spend 1-6 ammo: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. The difficulty for this attack is equal to the combined fight values of all enemies at your location. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage divided as you choose among enemies at your location. X is the amount of ammo spent as part of this ability's cost.

name: Blood of Thoth
text: [reaction] When 1 or more doom is placed on a card you control, exhaust Blood of Thoth: Place 1 resource on this card (from the token pool), as an offering. [fast] If Blood of Thoth has 3 or more offerings on it, remove all offerings from Blood of Thoth and exhaust it: Choose an investigator at your location to immediately take an action as if it were their turn.

name: Breath of the Sleeper
text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Fight. Use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, this attack deals +2 damage.

name: Eyes of the Dreamer
text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Investigate. Use your [willpower] instead of your [intellect] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: The Great Work
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
You earn 1 additional experience after each scenario of this campaign. If you are defeated, you are usurped by the homunculus (replace each signature card in your deck with a random basic weakness, flip this card, and swap it with your investigator for the remainder of the campaign).

name: Lost Homunculus
text: Cannot be chosen as a starting investigator. You cannot add, remove, or upgrade cards from your deck. You get +2 skill value while resolving abilities on [[Spell]] cards. Forced - When you are defeated: You are killed. [elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card.
flavor: You always wanted to be human.

name: Katarina Sojka
text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token during a skill test you are performing, exhaust Katarina Sojka: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag until a token with a symbol is revealed. Resolve that token and ignore the rest.

name: Sign of Xelotaph
text: Myriad. Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Uses (3 charges). Forced - When your turn begins: You must spend 1 charge or discard Sign of Xelotaph. [fast] Discard a copy of Sign of Xelotaph from your hand: Replenish all charges on this copy of Sign of Xelotaph.

name: Spectral Shield
text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to a player card with health and/or sanity at your location. Forced - When attached card takes 1 or more damage/horror: Cancel 1 of that damage/horror. The owner of Spectral Shield must remove 1 charge from an asset they control. If they cannot, discard Spectral Shield.

name: Whispers of Doom
text: Parley. Choose a non-weakness enemy at your location and test [willpower] (3). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is that enemy's horror value. If you succeed, defeat that enemy (or deal it 3 damage instead if it is [[Elite]]). If you fail, place 1 doom on that enemy.

name: Eye of Ghatanothoa
text:
Exceptional.
You get +1 [willpower].
Play with the top card of the encounter deck revealed.
flavor: The universe has a favor to ask.

name: Sword Cane
text: Fast. [reaction] After Sword Cane enters play: You may deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. Immediately trigger the "[action]" ability below without paying its cost. [action] Exhaust Sword Cane: Fight/Evade. You may use your [willpower] in place of your [combat] or [agility] for this attack or evasion attempt and you get +1 skill value for this test.
subname: Designed by the Council of Polls

name: Spiritual Echo
text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. [reaction] After you activate an [action] or [fast] ability on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset: Perform that ability again at attached location as if you were there, ignoring that asset's [action] cost, if any. (You may trigger this ability from any location.) Return Spiritual Echo to your hand.

name: Transfiguration
text: Choose another investigator card from your collection. Until the end of the game, treat the front of your investigator card as if it were the front of the chosen card, instead (including your skill values, traits, abilities, and elder sign effect). Max once per game.

name: Enraptured
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place up to 3 charges and/or secrets on assets controlled by investigators at your location.

name: Lost Arcana
text:
Uses (2 charges).
Charges on Lost Arcana may be spent as if they were charges on [[Spell]] and [[Ritual]] assets you control.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Lost Arcana: Place 1 charge on this card.

name: Deliverance
text:
Fast. Play when the "draw encounter cards" step of the mythos phase would begin.
You draw each encounter card that would normally be drawn this mythos phase. Cards drawn during this mythos phase cannot be cancelled, and the first card drawn gains surge.
Skip the "draw encounter cards" step of the next mythos phase. Max twice per game.

name: Eldritch Brand
text: Permanent. Exceptional. When you purchase this card, choose a non-signature [[Spell]] asset in your deck and record [spell's name] was branded in your campaign log. This is your branded spell. Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of your branded spell. [reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for your branded spell and play it (paying its cost).

name: Anchor Chain
text: While Anchor Chain is in your hand, you may perform the below "[action]" ability. If you do, discard Anchor Chain instead of exhausting it. [action] Exhaust Anchor Chain: Evade. You get +1 [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you successfully evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy, you may discard 1 card from hand to prevent that enemy from readying during the next upkeep phase.

name: Hand Hook
text: While Hand Hook is in your hand, you may perform the below "[action]" ability. If you do, discard Hand Hook instead of exhausting it. [action] Exhaust Hand Hook: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may discard 1 card from hand to have this attack deal +1 damage.

name: Lawrence Carlisle
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discard 1 or more cards from your hand during your turn, exhaust Lawrence Carlisle: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "Each block of clay hides all manner of fantastical things."

name: Nautical Charts
text: While Nautical Charts is in your hand, you may perform the below "[action]" ability. If you do, discard Nautical Charts instead of exhausting it. [action] Exhaust Nautical Charts: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may discard 1 card from hand to discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Profane Idol
text: Profane Idol can only be played from your discard pile. Forced - When Profane Idol is defeated: Shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: "Catch!"
text: As an additional cost to play "Catch!", choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Evade. You get +X [agility] for this evasion attempt, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed against a non-[[Elite]] enemy and that asset was in your play area, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: Unconventional Method
text: As an additional cost to play Unconventional Method, choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Investigate. You get +X [intellect] for this investigation, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed and that asset was in your play area, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Contemplative
text:
You may commit Contemplative to an investigation or skill test during a parley attempt at your location or a connecting location.
If this test is successful, the performing investigator discovers 1 clue at their location.

name: Ample Supplies
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (2 supplies).
[reaction] After you discard 1 or more cards from hand, exhaust Ample Supplies: Place 1 supply on this card.
[fast] Discard Ample Supplies: Move each supply on this card to your resource pool, as resources.

name: A Glimmer of Hope
text: Myriad. A Glimmer of Hope can only be played from your discard pile. Add all copies of A Glimmer of Hope in your discard pile to your hand (including this copy).

name: Good Weather
text: Myriad. Fast. Play after the investigation phase begins. Group limit 1 in play. Put Good Weather into play next to the agenda deck and choose a skill. While this card is in play, each investigator gets +2 to the chosen skill. Forced - When the investigation phase begins: Discard Good Weather.

name: Improvised Weapon
text: You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects and draw 1 card. Fight. The attacked enemy gets -2 fight for this attack. (If you played Improvised Weapon from your discard pile, this attack deals +1 damage.)

name: Last Chance

name: The Undersea Vault [tdc_rune_z]
text:
You press three small hidden nodes inset into the vault door and it slides open with a satisfying hiss. Inside is a desiccated corpse of an alien creature, its octopoid face and leathery wings reduced to dust. It holds an obsidian slate in one bony hand; you identify it as a kind of city map, likely of R'lyeh itself.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_z] In your Campaign Log, record "City" under [tdc_rune_z] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

name: Deep One Matron
text: Hunter. Spawn - Any revealed location (Drowned Shanty, if able). Forced - When Deep One Matron enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Deep One]] enemy and spawn it at this location.
spawn: Any revealed location (Drowned Shanty, if able)

name: "Look Out!"
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). If you fail, put "Look Out!" into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you enter a flooded location each round: Take 1 horror. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard "Look Out!"

name: Hunting Parasite
text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Bearer only. Spawn - A connecting location (empty if able). Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Place 1 doom on a player card at this enemy's location. Then, discard Hunting Parasite.

name: The Drowned Quarter
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of revealed locations (rounded down).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail and your location is fully flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing]: -3 (-5 instead if your location is not flooded).
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of revealed locations.
[cultist]: -3. If your location is flooded, take 1 damage.
[tablet]: -4. For each point you fail by, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing]: -4 (-6 instead if your location is not flooded).

name: The Sunken Ruins
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.
flavor: Chunks of R'lyeh's foundation continue to fall, threatening the seafloor dome.

name: Seafloor Leviathan
text: Massive. Patrol (nearest unflooded or partially flooded location). Spawn - Barrier Core. Seafloor Leviathan gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if this enemy is ready: Increase the flood level of its location.

name: Collapsing Dome
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location or decrease the flood level of your current location, take 5 direct damage.
backText: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The dome won't hold up much longer against the barrage of falling rock.

name: Reactivate the Core
text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – At the end of the round, if each surviving investigator is at Barrier Core (Active), you may advance. (Hint: Reactivate the Barrier Core by revealing and draining locations!)
backText:
If an investigator controls the Barrier Node:
The strange orb sends a ripple of energy throughout the orrery and the surrounding dome. By pulling the node free, you have stolen the only thing powering the dome. A tremor shakes the structure as the energy field up above begins to dissipate!
(→R1) (page 18).
Otherwise:
The alien machinery hums with an otherworldly current. Overhead, a massive chunk of rock falls from the foundation and passes through the flickering energy field. The structure seems to have been stabilized.
(→R2) (page 18)
flavor: You can't open the barrier core until the undersea dome is at least partially drained.

name: Barrier Core
text: Forced - If 6 or more [[Seafloor]] locations are revealed and not flooded: Flip Barrier Core. [action] Decrease the flood level of Barrier Core and choose an adjacent eligible location: Increase the flood level of the chosen location. Then, place 3 [per_investigator] clues on it. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Barrier Core
text: Forced - If there are 5 or fewer unflooded [[Seafloor]] locations: Flip Barrier Core. [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Barrier Node story asset into play under your control.

name: Abyssal Trench
text:
X is equal to half of the number of revealed [[Seafloor]] locations (rounded down).
[reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an enemy at Abyssal Trench: Decrease its flood level. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.
flavor: The seafloor trench feels as alien as another dimension.

name: Drowned Acropolis
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Drowned Acropolis: You must either increase its flood level or take 1 horror. [action] Increase the flood level of Drowned Acropolis: Choose any location and decrease its flood level. (Group limit twice per game.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Drowned Acropolis
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Drowned Acropolis: You must either increase the flood level of an adjacent location or take 1 damage. [action] Increase the flood level of Drowned Acropolis: Choose any location and decrease its flood level. (Group limit twice per game.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Blasted Ruins
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Blasted Ruins: Increase its flood level. [action] Investigators at Blasted Ruins spend 5 resources, as a group: Decrease the flood level of this location or an adjacent location. (Group limit once per round.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Blasted Ruins
text: Forced - After you end your turn at Blasted Ruins: Increase its flood level. [action] Investigators at Blasted Ruins discard a total of 1 [per_investigator] cards from hand, as a group: Decrease the flood level of this location or an adjacent location. (Group limit once per round.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Coral Reef
text: [action][action]: Draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources. Spawn the set-aside Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] enemy at this location. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Coral Reef
text: Forced - After Coral Reef is revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and spawn it at this location. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at Coral Reef: Spawn the set-aside Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] enemy at this location.
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Ancient Gallery
text: [action] Choose and discard 2 cards from your hand: Put the set-aside Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y] asset into play under your control. (Group limit once per game.)
backText: Forced - When you enter Sea Floor: Increase the flood level of this location and an adjacent eligible location.

name: Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x]
text: Aloof. Retaliate. Forced - After Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] attacks you: Flip this card and resolve its text. Forced - When Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] would leave play: Flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x]
text:
If this card flipped because Undersea Parasite [tdc_rune_x] attacked you, read the following:
The creature's bite burns like fire. Before you can react, it has vanished into a maze of coral.
Flip this card and move it to a connecting location (with no investigators, if able). Otherwise:
After crushing the loathsome creature's carapace, you catch a glint of something. An alien symbol?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_x] In your Campaign Log, record "Sum" under [tdc_rune_x] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y]
text:
If Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y] would leave play, remove it from the game.
[action]: Test [intellect] (8). Double the skill icons of each card committed to this skill test. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Obsidian Relic [tdc_rune_y]
text:
Pressing a small inset in the relic's base opens the statue's center with a strange hiss, unfolding like an obsidian blossom. A light projection extends over the relic's open core, showing hazy scenes of a crashing alien shoreline and nameless horrors silhouetted against the sky. A cnidarian creature looms over a crowd of squamous larvae, grasping a glowing tablet in a tangle of viscous tentacles. Was this some kind of otherworldly sage? An alien leader, perhaps?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_y] In your Campaign Log, record "Knowledge" under [tdc_rune_y] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Medusa
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest unflooded or partially flooded location). Forced - When the enemy phase begins, if Medusa is ready: Increase the flood level of its location. If you cannot, place 1 doom on Medusa.
flavor: Not your average jellyfish.

name: Barrier Node
text:
Barrier Node cannot be defeated or leave play.
[reaction] When your turn begins: Heal 1 damage from Barrier Node.
[tdc_rune_q] · [tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_g] · [tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_s]
Barrier Node gets +2 health.

name: The Apiary
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the amount of doom on enemies and assets in play, rounded down (to a max of 4).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a [[Cultist]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on an enemy at your location with no doom on it.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, take 1 damage or 1 horror.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the amount of doom on enemies and assets in play (to a max of 8).
[cultist]: -3. If there is a [[Cultist]] enemy at your location, reveal another token.
[tablet]: -5. If you fail, place 1 doom on an enemy at your location (with no doom on it, if able).
[elder_thing]: -6. If you fail, take 1 damage or 1 horror.

name: Stirring in the Dark
backText: Place clues on each location without victory X up to its clue value. Shuffle the set-aside Grotesque Amalgam enemy with the encounter discard pile and place those cards on the bottom of the encounter deck.
flavor: You can hear the sound of slithering and gnashing teeth in the darkness. Something awful stirs in the bowels of R'lyeh. You would rather not stick around to find out what it actually is...

name: Loathsome Parasites
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if there are no non-[[Elite]] enemies in play: Reveal cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is revealed and spawn it (at an empty location, if able). Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the encounter deck.
backText: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
flavor: Loathsome creatures emerge from every nook and cranny. If you don't escape soon, you have a feeling you'll become a permanent resident.

name: Unsettling Signs
text: [action] Spend 1 or more clues, as a group: For each clue spent, discard the top 5 cards (10 cards instead if there is 1 investigator) of the encounter deck and draw each location discarded by this effect. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at a [[Sanctum]] location, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.(Hint: you may not be able to explore further after you advance.)
backText:
If each investigator is at Lost Campsite:
After searching the campsite, you find yourselves surrounded by robed figures holding torches, but no weapons. A soft-faced woman in a patchwork cloak emerges from the crowd. "Please, don't be alarmed. We have no intention of harming you."
Each investigator loses all of their clues. Proceed to Interlude: Lost Pilgrims (page 21).
If each investigator is at Acidic Coelom:
You hear a hiss, then feel sharp, stinging pain in your back. As you lose consciousness, look around and see a prehensile limb buried in your spine.
Each investigator loses all of their clues. Proceed to Interlude: The Hive Mind (page 22).
flavor: The fleshy tunnels excrete a foul, waxy substance that burns the skin. Your destination lies deeper within the disgusting labyrinth.

name: Lost Pilgrims
text: Each [[Cultist]] enemy gains victory 0 and aloof. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) or [combat] (2). For each point you succeed by, move a different [[Cultist]] enemy at your location once in any direction. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Each [[Cultist]] enemy takes 1 damage for each [[Stowaway]] enemy at its location. Objective - When the round ends, if there is a combined total of 5 or more [[Cultist]] cards in the victory display and/or under this act, you must advance.
backText:
If there are 3 or more Cultist cards under this act:
The tunnels buckle and spasm as you flee the apiary. You usher the last of the surviving pilgrims out as the alien parasites screech in primal rage behind you. You are safe... for now.
(→R1) (page 23).
Otherwise:
The tunnels buckle and spasm as you flee the apiary. You hear the pilgrims' agonized screams behind you. Suddenly the screams stop, replaced by the sound of gnashing mouths and tearing flesh. You were one of the fortunate ones.
(→R2) (page 23).
flavor: The campsite is under attack by alien parasites!

name: The Hive Mind
text: [fast] During your turn, place X clues on your location: Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the round ends: Flip a coin. On heads, rotate Central Chamber once clockwise. On tails, rotate Central Chamber once counter-clockwise. Objective - If Mother is defeated, immediately advance.
flavor: It doesn't live in the walls! It is the walls!

name: Apiary Entrance
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Shuffle each location in the encounter discard pile into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [fast]: Choose the farthest location from Apiary Entrance. Place clues on the chosen location up to its clue value. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

name: Apiary Entrance
text: When a [[Stowaway]] enemy is drawn, spawn it at Apiary Entrance instead of its normal spawn location. [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place a [[Cultist]] asset or enemy at this location underneath the act. [action]: Resign. You make your exit.

name: Fleshy Paths
text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths into play. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search the flesh-like walls. If you succeed, put the set-aside Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] asset into play under your control.

name: Fleshy Paths [tdc_rune_r]
text: Revelation - Put Fleshy Paths [tdc_rune_r] into play. [action] You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_r] In your Campaign Log, record "Time" under [tdc_rune_r] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Growing Fields
text: Revelation - Put Growing Fields into play along with the set-aside Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] location. [action]: Test [willpower] (8). Double the skill icons of each card committed to this test. If you succeed, take control of the set-aside Grisly "Mask" story asset.

name: Churning Chasm
text: Revelation - Put Churning Chasm into play and spawn the set-aside Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] enemy at it. [reaction] When you begin your turn in Churning Chasm: Move to any revealed location.

name: Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q]
text: Revelation - Put Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] into play. [action][action]: You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_q] In your Campaign Log, record "Hand" under [tdc_rune_q] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

name: Luminous Tunnels
text: Revelation - Put Luminous Tunnels into play. Shuffle the set-aside Pilgrims encounter set into the encounter deck along with the encounter discard pile. Find the set-aside Spawning Grounds and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 damage: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

name: Spawning Grounds
text: Revelation - Put Spawning Grounds into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Lost Campsite and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Lost Campsite
text: Revelation - Put Lost Campsite into play. [action]: Draw the topmost card beneath Lost Campsite.
flavor: The camp is seemingly abandoned, strewn with dishware and tattered tents. Perhaps there are survivors hiding nearby.

name: Maria Rivera
text: When damage would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy at your location, place it on Maria Rivera instead. [reaction] When doom would be placed on a [[Cultist]] enemy, exhaust Maria Rivera: Place it on Maria Rivera instead, as damage. Forced - If Maria Rivera is defeated: Add her to the victory display.

name: Grasping Corridor
text: Revelation - Put Grasping Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Starving Corridor and Corrupted Vault [tdc_rune_q] and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck. [action] Take 1 horror: Place clues on the location farthest from Apiary Entrance up to its clue value.

name: Starving Corridor
text: Revelation - Put Starving Corridor into play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Find the set-aside Acidic Coelom and Churning Chasm and shuffle them into the bottom 10 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Acidic Coelom
text: Revelation - Put Acidic Coelom into play. As an additional cost to move from Acidic Coelom to Apiary Entrance, you must take 1 damage.
flavor: The acidic vapors digest anything inside the chamber, including flesh and metal.

name: Central Chamber
text: Central Chamber is connected to the location below it (bordering its bottom edge) and vice versa. Forced - When your turn ends, if you are at this location: Test [agility] (1). If you fail, you must either move to a connecting location or Mother attacks you.
backText: Central Chamber is connected to the location below it (bordering its bottom edge) and vice versa.

name: Mother
text: Massive. Relentless. Forced - When another [[Stowaway]] enemy is defeated: Move all damage on that enemy to Mother. (If that enemy had doom on it, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck as well.)

name: Grotesque Amalgam
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After you fight this enemy using a [[Weapon]] asset: Place 1 doom on that asset.

name: Apiary Tender
text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Forced - When doom is placed on a card at this location: Ready Apiary Tender. It loses aloof until the end of the round. If it is engaged with an investigator, it makes an immediate attack.

name: Hungry Walls
text: Revelation - Attach this card to your location. Forced - When you leave attached location: Test [agility] (4) or [combat] (4). If you fail and you tested... - ...[agility], discard an asset you control and take 1 damage. Discard Hungry Walls. - ...[combat], take 2 direct damage. Discard Hungry Walls.

name: Dangerous Curiosity
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shroud value. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Stowaway]] enemy is discarded and draw it. Shuffle each location discarded by this effect back into the encounter deck.

name: Alien Eggs
text: Surge. Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy with no doom on it.
flavor: What is that moving inside?

name: Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u]
text: Forced - After Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy and spawn it at this location. [reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy at Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u] by 2 or more: Flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Hidden Vault [tdc_rune_u]
text:
You find an alien panel hidden behind a fold of fleshy wall. Grimacing, you press it and reveal a round alcove untouched by the alien growths. Sharp glowing symbols connected by curling lines appear on a black slate in the center of the alcove. After some study, you recognize it as some kind of ancestral tree. There are hundreds upon hundreds of names: how many creatures lived in this city aeons ago?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_u] In your Campaign Log, record "Daughters" under [tdc_rune_u] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Flip this card back to its location side. It cannot be flipped over again.

name: Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]
text: Retaliate. If Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. Forced - When you defeat Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]: Flip this enemy and resolve its text.

name: Squamous Parasite [tdc_rune_t]
text:
The alien creature's hard carapace crumbles to reveal a shining black sigil. It must have devoured this piece of technology... or was it assembled from it? Pressing the sigil projects an image of a cloudy golden sky. Somewhere not of this world. A series of glyphs and descending lines overlay the scene. Eventually, their meaning becomes clear.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_t] In your Campaign Log, record "Air" under [tdc_rune_t] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s]
text: If Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Deal 1 damage to Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s]. [reaction] When you end the game with Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s] under your control: Flip this card and resolve its text.

name: Ancient Relic [tdc_rune_s]
text:
Twisting portions of the relic unlocks a small cylinder in the center. Inside the cylinder is an even smaller version of the same relic, and within the smaller relic is a glittering gem. Holding it up to the light projects a series of small dots that form some kind of code. One of the expedition members identifies it as a blueprint of sorts: the symbols appear to be instructions for repairing some kind of machine.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_s] In your Campaign Log, record "Machine" under [tdc_rune_s] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Grisly "Mask"
text:
[fast] Exhaust Grisly "Mask": Disengage from each enemy. Until the beginning of your next turn, you cannot move and cannot damage enemies or engage them.
[tdc_rune_j] · [tdc_rune_m] · [tdc_rune_s] · [tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_b]
[fast] Take 1 direct horror and exhaust Grisly "Mask": Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: Parasitic Transformation
text: Revelation - Put Parasitic Transformation into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy engages you: Place 1 doom on Parasitic Transformation. [action][action]: Discard Parasitic Transformation.

name: The Grand Vault
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of activated locations (rounded down).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, you must either deactivate your location or take 1 damage or 1 horror.
[tablet]: -2 (-3 instead if your location is partially flooded; -4 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, search the encounter discard pile for a copy of the Still Behind You treachery and add it to the victory display.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of activated locations.
[cultist]: -4. After this test resolves, you must either deactivate your location or take 1 damage and 1 horror.
[tablet]: -3 (-4 instead if your location is partially flooded; -5 instead if your location is fully flooded).
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, search the encounter discard pile for a copy of the Still Behind You treachery and draw it.

name: Bowels of the City
text: Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
backText:
Spawn the set-aside The Inescapable enemy at the lead investigator's location. Choose an investigator at that location to test [agility] (4). If they succeed, disengage The Inescapable from each investigator and exhaust it.
Shuffle each copy of the set-aside Still Behind You treachery and 1 random set-aside [[Star Spawn]] enemy, along with the encounter deck and discard pile, into the encounter deck.
flavor: The oppressive darkness is filled with the sound of crushing, gnashing machinery.

name: Devil in the Machine
text: The Inescapable gets +1 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
backText:
Search all in- and out-of-play areas for each copy of the Still Behind You treachery. Shuffle these cards, the set-aside [[Star Spawn]] enemy, and the encounter discard pile, into the encounter deck.
Move each unengaged Persistent Construct enemy in play to the Moving Platform, exhausted and unengaged.
If The Inescapable is in play, heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from it and move it once toward the nearest investigator. Each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location during this movement.
flavor: This thing won't stop unless you find a way to put it down for good.

name: Ever-Shifting Walls
text: The Inescapable gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. Forced - When your turn begins, if your location is fully flooded, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter a partially flooded or unflooded location during your turn, or decrease your location's flood level, take 5 direct damage.
backText: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: With great effort and no small amount of luck, you may still be able to escape.

name: Careful Navigation
text: [reaction] After the investigators have translated any 3 of the following glyphs ([tdc_rune_l], [tdc_rune_m], [tdc_rune_n], [tdc_rune_p], [tdc_rune_o]): Reveal the Sealed Chamber location. (Hint: Each of these glyphs are found in this scenario.). Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator controls the Tidal Tablet story asset, advance.
backText: Increase the flood level of each location that can have its flood level increased. Place clues on each revealed [[Vault]] location without victory X up to its clue threshold.
flavor: The machinery that serves as the beating heart of R'lyeh is alien in design, but not inscrutable. Thanks to all you've learned up to this point, you may be able to find your way through.

name: Back Through the Machine
text: Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
backText: Check your Campaign log. - If the expedition headed west, (→R1) (page 27). - If the expedition headed east, (→R2) (page 27).

text:
A small switch at the base of the wall opens into a cramped musty room. As you enter, a small glyph in the floor begins to glow a dim green. The light intensifies until it is blindingly bright, and the air in the room begins to crackle with energy. The glyph flares even brighter, then goes dark. The symbol's meaning will forever be burned into your memory.

text:
Within the ancient vault is a large octagonal room that resembles a kind of laboratory. A central console resembles a clawed hand, with two of its "fingers" raised. Nodes in the console project a glowing translucent letter. Curious, you press one hand to a central node. A vision overwhelmes your mind: a torrential wave, a sundered mountain, burning forests and atmosphere. You pull one hand away, uncertain of what you just experienced. A record? A vision?
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_n] In your Campaign Log, record "Doom" under [tdc_rune_n] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

name: Ancient Vault [tdc_rune_p]
text:
The room within the vault is dark and featureless, save for an incandescent, smoky orb suspended in the center. Inspecting it closer, you find a full-scale model of an alien planet. Small storm systems move along the surface at an accelerated rate, swirling and dissipating in seconds. When you touch it, your senses are assailed by invisible gales, torrential rain, and a crack of thunder. Lines of swirling alien writing appear on the globe, conveying a record of an ancient storm.
You discover this glyph: [tdc_rune_p] In your Campaign Log, record "Weather" under [tdc_rune_p] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated. Add this card to the victory display.

text:

[tdc_rune_d]
In your Campaign Log, record "Wave" under [tdc_rune_d] on the glyph record. This glyph has been translated.

flavor: A brilliant map of distant nebulae fills the room, bursting with color and light. A cerulean glob near the edge draws your attention. Staring at it fills your mind with a sharp, chittering alien language and the crash of waves. As you begin to mouth the strange language, a symbol glimmers in the cerulean sphere. Looking at it fills you with a deep yearning, an instinct to dive into deep underwater nests. Is this a word you learned, or an ancient, primordial memory recalled?

text:

text:
You discover the following glyph:
[tdc_rune_f]

flavor: Twisting a hidden knob in the relic's base releases a shower of sparks. You nearly drop the relic from surprise, but the "sparks" are merely random pinpricks of light and thick clouds of fog that shift like oil on water. The more you look at them, the more they resemble constellations, patterns of distant stars. The projection looks nothing like the constellations you've seen before, however.

name: Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e]
text: Revelation - Attach Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] to your location. Cannot be canceled. If Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e] would leave play, set it aside, out of play. [action]: Test [combat] or [intellect] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. Otherwise, put 1 resource on this card. name: Eroded Frieze [tdc_rune_e]
text:
You discover this glyph:
[tdc_rune_e]

flavor: Parts of the frieze are worn smooth by the passage of time, but you eventually identify the shapes of mountains, clouds, mist. Within the mist, nightmarish shapes appear to be locked in some kind of struggle. Frightened creatures look up from below. Underneath it all, a cyclopean eye gazes intensely at an underground city deep below the surface. Heavy accenting depicts a roiling mist that fills the streets of the city. Each of the citizens reclines in a look of terrifying repose.

name: St. Elmo's Fire

flavor: You shouldn't have looked down.

text:

name: The Coming Storm
text: [action]: Resign. You give up your search. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Increase the flood level of the lead investigator's location.
backText: Each investigator who has not been eliminated immediately resigns.
flavor: The downpour worsens. As the streets begin to flood, terrifying creatures emerge from the shadows: creatures that could only have come from R'lyeh.

name: The Phantom Shop
text: [action] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the top card beneath your location. If it is an asset, take control of it. Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator at Tillinghast Esoterica controls at least 1 [[Artifact]] asset, the investigators may advance. (Hint: Recover as many artifacts as possible!)
backText:
If the investigators control 5 or more Artifact assets:
"I have worked too hard to see my plans undone," Randall seethes. Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as he grasps at you weakly. Pulse pounding, you run for the shop exit and barrel out into the street. When you turn to look, the shop door has vanished yet again.
(→R1) (page 46).
Otherwise:
"You're too late!" Randall wheezes, clutching his side. "The destruction of Arkham is at hand and you are powerless to stop it." Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as tchotchkes and ancient tomes fly off the shelves and hang suspended mid-air. Your vision blurs, then you find yourself back on the street. The shop has vanished yet again.
Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience. (→R2) (page 46).
flavor: Conflicting accounts place Tillinghast Esoterica in locations across Arkham.

name: Tillinghast Esoterica
text: Revelation - Put Tillinghast Esoterica into play adjacent to your location and spawn the set-aside Randall Tillinghast at it. Shuffle each set-aside [[Artifact]] asset and place them underneath it as a stack. Tillinghast Esoterica is connected to the location from which it was drawn, and vice versa. [fast]: Place clues on this location up to its clue value.

text:

Discard each clue and attachment at that location, and swap it with its set-aside [[Ruined]] version, unrevealed side faceup. name: Banish Him!
text: [fast] During an attack at your location, spend 1 clue: That attack deals +1 damage. (Max once per attack.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 3 [[Cthulhu]] enemies in the victory display, advance.
backText: Return each [[Cthulhu]] enemy in the victory display to its place on the Cthulhu Board, non-[[Enraged]] side faceup. Increase Cthulhu's Rage by 1. If Cthulhu's Rage is 3 or less, flip back to act 1a. Otherwise, if Cthulhu's Rage is 4 or more: - Set Cthulhu's Rage to 5 (4 instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators). Flip each [[Cthulhu]] enemy to its [[Enraged]] side, ignoring its Forced effect. - Place clues on each revealed location without Victory X up to its clue value. - In player order, each investigator may take control of 1 set-aside [[Ally]] story asset. They do not take up an ally slot for the remainder of this scenario. - Advance the act and agenda deck to The Final Seal special agenda and place 1 [per_investigator] doom on it. It is both the current act and the current agenda.

If each [[Cthulhu]] enemy is in the victory display and there are 5 locations with sigils on them, immediately advance.

text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards one card from hand at random. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks the investigator with the highest [willpower] at Chulhu's location. text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The nearest investigator to Cthulhu must test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If that investigator fails, Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) attacks them. text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: Each investigator at Cthulhu's location discards 1 card at random from hand. Resolve Cthulhu's patrol keyword an additional time. If Cthulhu (Fierce Visage) is in play: The investigator with the highest [willpower] tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they must either take 1 horror, or choose and discard a non-story asset they control. If Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) is in play: If Cthulhu did not move via his patrol keyword this round, Cthulhu (Wicked Claw) attacks each investigator at its location.

name: Dreadsight
text: If Cthulhu (Hoary Wings) is in play: The investigator with the highest [agility] tests [agility] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If they fail, they take 1 damage or 1 horror. text:

text:

text: Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Search the chaos bag and all in- and out-of-play areas for the [elder_sign] token and seal it on this card. text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Gross Plasticity
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Increase the flood level of your location. - Each investigator takes 1 damage or 1 horror.

name: Arkham Under Assault
text: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (X), where X is Cthulhu's Rage. If 1 or more investigators fail, draw the top card of the Cthulhu deck.
flavor: [tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_j][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_h] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_p] · [tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_x] · [tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_q][tdc_rune_k]

name: Stowaway Drone
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest other enemy with no doom on it ). Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Place 1 doom on another non-[[Elite]] enemy at this location. Then, discard Stowaway Drone.

name: Infected!
text: Revelation - Put Infected! into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you end your turn at a location with another investigator or a [[Stowaway]] enemy: Place 1 doom on Infected! [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you succeed, discard Infected!

name: Pilgrim Acolyte
text: Forced - After Pilgrim Acolyte attacks: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor: "…the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among them by moulding their dreams." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"

name: Pilgrim Leader
text: Aloof. Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). While Pilgrim Leader is ready, each other [[Cultist]] enemy gets +2 fight and gains hunter and relentless.

name: Monstrous Star Spawn
text: Hunter. Massive. Relentless. Prey - Highest [combat]. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading this enemy: Heal 1 damage from it.

name: Infected Star Spawn
text: Hunter. Relentless. Prey - Highest [agility]. Forced - The first time this enemy would be defeated: Heal all damage from it and ready it. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading Infected Star Spawn: Take 1 horror.

name: Coral Star Spawn
text: Hunter. Relentless. Prey - Highest [willpower]. While Coral Star Spawn has damage on it, it gains alert and retaliate. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while fighting or evading this enemy: Take 1 damage.

name: Star Spawn Observer
text: Aloof. Hunter. Prey - Highest [intellect]. Forced - When you reveal an [elder_thing] token while investigating Star Spawn Observer's location: It engages you and makes an immediate attack.

name: Eye of the Deep
text: Revelation - Put Eye of the Deep into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Treat each [cultist] and [tablet] token you reveal during a skill test as if it were an [elder_thing] token, instead. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Eye of the Deep.

name: Cunning Mimicry
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Monster]] enemies in play, Cunning Mimicry gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (3). If you fail, the nearest [[Monster]] enemy attacks you (regardless of its current location).

name: Elder Mist
text: Revelation - Attach Elder Mist to the nearest location without Elder Mist attached. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect],-1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - After an investigator at attached location succeeds at a skill test by 2 or more: Discard Elder Mist.

name: Corrosive Fog
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] or [combat] (4). If you fail, take 1 damage. If you fail by 3 or more, instead deal 1 direct damage to your investigator and each [[Ally]] and [[Item]] asset you control with health.

name: Voltaic Eel
text: Hunter. Prey - Most clues. While Voltaic Eel is moving during the enemy phase, each fully flooded location is considered to be connected to one another.

name: Dreaming Migration
text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, Dreaming Migration gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must choose one: - The nearest enemy moves to your location and makes an immediate attack. - Draw the topmost enemy in the encounter discard pile.

name: Undersea Hunt
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if your location is fully flooded. If you fail, take 1 damage and increase the flood level of the nearest eligible location.

name: Deadly Torrent
text: Revelation - If your location is unflooded, Deadly Torrent gains surge. Otherwise, you must choose: - Test [agility] (4) to swim to safety. If you succeed, move to a connecting location. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - Test [combat] (4) to stand your ground. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard 1 asset you control that takes up 1 or more slots.

name: Something in the Water
text: Surge. Revelation - Increase the flood level of the nearest eligible location.
flavor: "I cannot think of the deep sea without shuddering at the nameless things that may at this very moment be crawling and floundering on its slimy bed..." - H.P. Lovecraft, "Dagon"

name: Ominous Silence
text: Revelation - Put Ominous Silence into play in your threat area. As an additional cost to play a card, you must either spend 1 resource or take 1 horror. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If your location is not flooded, this test automatically succeeds. If you succeed, discard Ominous Silence.

name: Cyclopean Architecture
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand (to a maximum of 3).
flavor: "He had an unprecedented dream of great Cyclopean cities of titan blocks and sky-flung monoliths..." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"

name: Crumbling Masonry
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor: "He said that the geometry of the dream-place he saw was abnormal, non-Euclidean, and loathsomely redolent of spheres and dimensions apart from ours." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"

name: "Cthulhu fhtagn!"
text: Revelation - Test [combat] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or deal 1 direct damage to an investigator at your location.
flavor: [tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f] · [tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_x][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_l][tdc_rune_k] · [tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_c] · [tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_h][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_b] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_z] · [tdc_rune_u][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_n][tdc_rune_p][tdc_rune_b][tdc_rune_n] · [tdc_rune_g][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_c][tdc_rune_l] · [tdc_rune_z][tdc_rune_s][tdc_rune_k][tdc_rune_d][tdc_rune_o][tdc_rune_m][tdc_rune_f][tdc_rune_e]

name: Oppressive Influence
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's printed shroud. If you fail, take 2 horror.
flavor: "I have looked upon all the universe has to hold of horror, and even the skies of spring and flowers of summer must ever afterward be poison to me." - H.P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"

name: Domination
text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. - Each investigator discards 2 cards from their hand. - Each investigator loses 1 action.

name: The Inescapable
text: Hunter. Relentless. Spawn - Any connecting location (empty, if able). Forced - The first time each round an [elder_thing] token is revealed from the chaos bag: Ready The Inescapable and resolve its hunter keyword (it does not attack).

name: Still Behind You
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each copy of Still Behind You in the victory display. If you fail and The Inescapable... - ...is in play, it moves, one location at a time, to your location and engages you. - ...is not in play, search all in- and out-of-play areas for The Inescapable and draw it. Add Still Behind You in the victory display.

name: Deep One Thrall
text: Forced - After Deep One Thrall engages you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.
flavor: A hunter perfectly adapted to the lightless deep.

name: Elder Deep One
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Each other [[Deep One]] enemy gains relentless. Forced - After Elder Deep One engages you: Heal 1 damage from each other [[Deep One]] enemy in play.

name: Deep One Ambush
text: Revelation - Put Deep One Ambush into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After a [[Deep One]] enemy engages you: It attacks you. Then, discard Deep One Ambush.
flavor: "Be careful out there. We have no idea what's lurking in the shadows."

name: Tortured Visions
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). This test gets +2 difficulty if you have 3 or fewer cards in your hand. If you fail, take 1 direct horror and discard 1 card at random from your hand.
